verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's ecosystem documents a first-party CLI reference for its Computer component, but that CLI has exactly one command, `cptr run`. It appears to launch the service rather than offer scriptable, agent-facing workflows from the terminal. missing for 10: CLI commands beyond launching (e.g. chatting, managing models/tools/automations from the terminal), documented AI-native or scripting use cases, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CLI has exactly one command: cptr run
From zero to your real files in a browser, in about two minutes. You need Python 3.10+
